title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Time, Speed, and Distance
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: Brishti went on an 8-hour trip in a car. Before the trip, the car had travelled a total of $x$ km till then, where $x$ is a whole number and is palindromic, i.e., $x$ remains unchanged when its digits are reversed. At the end of the trip, the car had travelled a total of 26862 km till then, this number again being palindromic. If Brishti never drove at more than 110 km / h, then the greatest possible average speed at which she drove during the trip, in km / h, was
questions.explain:
The final reading is 26862 km. Maximum distance driven = $110 \times 8 = 880$ km. 
So, the starting reading $x$ must be $\ge 26862 - 880 = 25982$. 
The number $x$ must also be a palindrome. We look for a 5-digit palindrome slightly less than 26862 but greater than 25982. 
Palindromes of the format $26a62$: the options are $26062, 26162, \dots, 26862$. 
The minimum valid palindrome $x$ that is $\ge 25982$ is 26062. 
The distance travelled would be $26862 - 26062 = 800$ km. 
The average speed is then $800 / 8 = 100$ km/h.

questions.q: Arvind travels from town A to town B, and Surbhi from town B to town A, both starting at the same time along the same route. After meeting each other, Arvind takes 6 hours to reach town B while Surbhi takes 24 hours to reach town A. If Arvind travelled at a speed of 54 km/h, then the distance, in km, between town A and town B is
questions.explain:
If two people meet and then take times $t_1$ and $t_2$ to reach their respective destinations, the ratio of their speeds is $v_1 / v_2 = \sqrt{t_2 / t_1}$. 
Here, $v_A / v_S = \sqrt{24 / 6} = \sqrt{4} = 2$. 
Given Arvind's speed $v_A = 54$ km/h, Surbhi's speed $v_S = 27$ km/h. 
The time taken by them to meet is $t = \sqrt{t_1 \times t_2} = \sqrt{6 \times 24} = 12$ hours. 
Arvind's total travel time is $12 + 6 = 18$ hours. The total distance is $18 \text{ hrs} \times 54 \text{ km/h} = 972$ km.
